description_en: Supports structured recognition and output of key fields such as invoice number, invoice code, and invoice amount
description_zh: 支持包括发票号码、发票代码、发票金额等关键字段结构化识别输出
kebab_example: aliyun ocr-api recognize-quota-invoice --url https://img.alicdn.com/tfs/TB1SwAeXHr1gK0jSZR0XXbP8XXa-870-604.jpg --biz-body '图片二进制文件' --region cn-hangzhou
name: RecognizeQuotaInvoice

parameters.help_en: Image URL (must not exceed 2048 bytes; base64 is not supported)
parameters.help_zh: 图片链接（长度不超2048字节，不支持 base64）
parameters.name: url

parameters.help_en: Binary file of the image, up to 10 MB. Either this or the URL parameter must be provided. When using an HTTP request, place the binary file directly in the HTTP body for upload. When using the software development kit (SDK), include the image in the SDK's body
parameters.help_zh: 图片二进制文件，最大10MB，与URL二选一。 使用HTTP方式调用，把图片二进制文件放到HTTP body 中上传即可。 使用SDK的方式调用，把图片放到SDK的body中即可
parameters.name: body
